text:
ops-bot: Quick week-1 readout for Blackwell B500 Dedicated preview pools. TL;DR: expanded Madrid + Seoul counts, added a small São Paulo pilot, HSM turned on for preview, and weve relaxed session caps for trusted teams. See below for details and action items.
eli_pm: Thanks everyone — excellent coordination. Summary bullets: 1) Madrid: +2 nodes (now 4, 16 GPUs) 2) Seoul: +1 node (now 4, 16 GPUs) 3) Sao Paulo (sa-east-1): pilot node opened (4 GPUs) for LATAM partner testing 4) Billing: preview still free-for-test, but we enabled reserved billing opt-in for a small set of partners.
sanjay_infra: Ops notes: we enabled HSM-backed KMS for the Madrid pool this morning (b500-mad-preview-hsm). Seoul will follow tomorrow. For São Paulo we deployed a single isolated node with full compliance controls disabled (do not run regulated datasets). Session policy change: bumped default max session from 6h -> 12h for users on the "trusted-preview" list to reduce churn during long evals.
marina_prod: Perf + stability summary: baseline latency (p50/p95) for GPT-like 8k context runs: Madrid p50 120ms/token, p95 340ms/token. Seoul p50 140ms/token, p95 380ms/token. São Paulo early numbers noisy due to network egress. We saw a recurring first-token jitter on ~3% of runs tied to cold kv-cache misses.
carlos_sre: Incidents: two small incidents this week. 1) Node reboot in Seoul due to a BIOS hang (root cause: vendor firmware bug) 1071045678 -> firmware patch applied, nodes drained during patch. 2) ECC memory alerts on one Madrid GPU that cleared after power-cycle. Both incidents did not impact customer traffic (preview only), but we are tracking DR docs and a firmware holdback policy for GA.
ben_security: Security update: HSM enabled in Madrid only. Were rolling out KMS access policies and key-rotation automation; expect SOC checklist in ~5 business days. Reminder: São Paulo pilot is NOT compliant; flag: do not ingest PII or regulated content.	
anya_sales: GTM guidance: partners on the reserved billing opt-in list: ProtoTech, LangLabs, and EdgeSense. If you were in the earlier form and not contacted, please DM me. Messaging: call this an "early performance pilot"  do not advertise GA or guaranteed capacity.
tom_gtm: Quick ask from channel: is there a way to grant partners extended session lengths without inviting them to the whole trusted list? Would prefer per-team exceptions.
sanjay_infra: Yes: we now support per-team session overrides via the infra-admin panel. CLI example to grant a 24h exception:
```
redwood infra override-session --team=prototypes --pool=b500-mad-preview-hsm --duration=24h --reason="partner eval"
```
eli_pm: Roadmap status: if firmware and ECC issues remain green next week, we plan to GA an expanded EU/AP wave in ~3 weeks. GA prerequisites: 1) vendor firmware sign-off 2) perf regression <5% vs baseline 3) compliance checklist complete for target regions.
marina_prod: Action items: - eng-runtime: post perf spreadsheet and CI job links in #eng-runtime (deadline: tomorrow EOD) - infra: complete Seoul HSM rollout (ETA: +24h) - SRE: add firmware holdback and auto-drain playbook to runbook (ETA: 3 days) - GTM: hold messaging, route inbound interest to anya_sales
carlos_sre: Dashboards: added a B500 topology view and a per-node health map. Alerts: new page rule for temp >= 82C and mem errs > 3/min during preview (were more conservative for early hardware).
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Done: created epic "b500-week1-readout" and added tasks from Marina's list. If you hit any data privacy flags in São Paulo pilot, DM ben_security immediately. Thanks team!
